meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会直接从宿主机的 .env 文件读取 API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌，并注入到容器环境中，不再经过 OneCLI 网关。
howto.when: 当你在 .env 中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 并配置了 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 或 CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 等凭证时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 .env 中的 API 密钥是否有效。
切换到使用 Claude 订阅令牌。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude reads the API key or OAuth token from the host's .env file and injects it into the container environment, bypassing the OneCLI gateway.
howto.when_en: Triggered when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env along with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN.

say_en.text: Check if the API key in .env is valid.
say_en.note: Claude reads the credential from .env and tries to connect to the Anthropic API.

say_en.text: Switch to using a Claude subscription token.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to run claude setup-token and update .env.
